# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GTest-based R verification
#
# The reference values in r_reference_*.hpp are generated by
# generate_r_reference.R and committed, so R is required neither to build nor to
# run these tests. R is never linked in: it runs as a separate process at
# generation time and only numbers cross the boundary, which keeps statcpp and
# this test binary under the MIT license.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)

add_executable(statcpp_r_tests
    test_vs_r_hypothesis.cpp
    test_vs_r_distributions.cpp
    test_vs_r_descriptive.cpp
    test_vs_r_regression.cpp
    test_vs_r_inference.cpp
    test_vs_r_applied.cpp
    test_vs_r_data.cpp
    test_vs_r_conditional.cpp
)

target_include_directories(statcpp_r_tests PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

target_link_libraries(statcpp_r_tests PRIVATE
    statcpp
    GTest::gtest_main
)

# Additional settings when sanitizers are enabled
if(STATCPP_ENABLE_SANITIZERS)
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
        target_compile_options(statcpp_r_tests PRIVATE
            -fsanitize=address,undefined
            -fno-omit-frame-pointer
            -g
        )
        target_link_options(statcpp_r_tests PRIVATE
            -fsanitize=address,undefined
        )
    endif()
endif()

# Integration with CTest
include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(statcpp_r_tests)

# Optional convenience target: regenerate the reference headers from R.
# Not part of the default build, and never required to run the tests.
find_program(RSCRIPT_EXECUTABLE Rscript)
if(RSCRIPT_EXECUTABLE)
    add_custom_target(regenerate_r_reference
        COMMAND ${RSCRIPT_EXECUTABLE} generate_r_reference.R
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        COMMENT "Regenerating R reference headers (requires R and its packages)"
        VERBATIM
    )
endif()
